messages:
Maya Patel: Heads up — Customer X asked for a clear migration path from per-tenant quotas to reserved pools. They want low-touch tooling so SREs don't have to hand-hold every onboarding. Can we sketch a playbook?

Dave Chen: 👍 we should include a safe fallback (autoscale degrade path) that throttles non-critical routes before failing customer requests.

Li Wei: Agree. Proposal: create a migration API that converts tenant slab -> pool reservation, with a timed grace window and carryover tokens. Minimal steps: 1) dry-run conversion; 2) opt-in pilot; 3) full cutover.

Maya Patel: Nice. Can you draft the dry-run output format? Customer ops want to see expected headroom and burst loss before committing.

Li Wei: Draft output (example):
```json
{
  "tenant": "acme",
  "old_quota": "100rps",
  "mapped_pool": "reserved-pool-us-west-1-a",
  "expected_headroom": "+20%",
  "burst_impact": "max 5% longer tails",
  "recommendation": "add 1 prewarm unit"
}
```

Dave Chen: We also need an autoscale degrade path doc. Roughly: 1) detect sustained queue > threshold; 2) enable degraded-mode routing (serve small models / cached responses); 3) apply soft-throttle to low-priority tenants; 4) if still overloaded, start token-limited errors with clear headers and metric tags.

Samir Rao: For implementation, ops-bot can trigger a simulated degrade in staging. Ops-bot: run-degrade-sim for pool reserved-pool-us-west-1-a?

ops-bot: scheduled simulation started for reserved-pool-us-west-1-a. Results ETA ~15m. :robot_face:

Maya Patel: Good. Add launch gates to the playbook: telemetry (per-route p50/p95/p99, token loss), migrations tested in 3 customers, rollback runbook, billing reconciliation tested, support runbooks updated, legal sign-off for contract changes.

Dave Chen: Also include a step for customer-visible migration report email template and a CLI command to rollback mapping within 10m. Example command: `rw migrate rollback --tenant acme --since 2026-01-10T14:00Z`

Li Wei: Edge case: tenants with live sessions and long-lived KV caches — migration should optionally preserve KV mapping and pin to same pool until session drains. Mark as opt-in.

Samir Rao: QA asks: create load tests that exercise burst tokens and carryover windows. Add a canary policy: run migration for 1% traffic → 10% → 100% with 24h observation windows.

Maya Patel: Perfect. Next steps: Li to produce a one-pager migration playbook + sample API/CLI and rollback commands by EOD Friday. Dave to write the "autoscale degrade path" runbook and error semantics. Samir to add sims/tests and ops-bot hooks. We'll sync Mon 10am for gating checklist.

Dave Chen: I'll also add metric tags: `migration.phase`, `degrade.mode`, `migration.rolled_back` for easier SLO queries.

Maya Patel: Thanks team. Quick ask — can we include a short customer-facing diagram for the migration flow? Even a 1-slide flow helps support.

Li Wei: Yep — will attach a draft by tomorrow.

ops-bot: simulation complete. Peak queue +22%, latency p95 +18ms, no error escalation in staging. :white_check_mark:
